decisions.reason: The DPA management software is cheap to maintain, fits the firm's stated compliance direction, and has positive agency feedback, so the option still has value and should stay open.
The configurable managed plan runs on owned infrastructure at little extra cost, but there is still no visible evidence of traction, so it stays as a low-cost option while its value resolves.

Extended PHP security support was only just launched, meets a real compliance and security need of agencies running legacy projects, and costs little on top of existing know-how, so it is too early to abandon it.
